title: One Order, One Form of Fulfilment: Delivery or Collection
content:
## 1. The form is fixed at placement

One order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is fulfilled by delivery or by collection, never by both, and
the fulfilment service chosen at placement fixes which. Whether the order has already been handed over is read from
the retailer's own record of that same order — its fulfilment service and its standing — before the handover is
recorded, so an order already standing fulfilled is not handed over a second time; where more than one handover stands
on one order, they are told apart by the day of handover and the window it fell in.

## 2. Changing from delivery to collection

A customer who wants to collect goods on a delivery order cancels it and places a collection order. The price is held
where the change is made inside the amendment cutoff.

## 3. Collection goods not collected

Collection goods are held for the fulfilment service's hold days and then returned to stock, with the daily storage
charge applied first where the service charges one.

## 4. Lines on a collection order

A part-collected order is not permitted: the lines on a collection order are handed over together or held together.

## 5. Who may take the goods

Identity is checked at collection where the fulfilment service requires it, and the goods are handed to the buyer, or
to a person the buyer named when the order was placed, and to nobody else.

## Points of judgement

**May a customer take some lines of a collection order now and the rest next week?** No. The lines are handed over
together or held together.

**Does the retailer switch a delivery order to collection?** The customer cancels the delivery order and places a
collection order; the price is held where that change is made inside the amendment cutoff.

**A friend arrives at the counter for the goods. May they be handed over?** Only where the buyer named that person when
the order was placed; the goods go to the buyer or to such a named person and to nobody else.

**What becomes of goods left uncollected?** They are returned to stock after the service's hold days, the daily storage
charge being applied first where the service charges one.
